name: JSI Wikifier
description: Annotates text with the Wikipedia and Wikidata concepts it mentions (entity linking), with optional Wikidata classes and DBpedia types.

operations.label: Annotate text
operations.description: Sends the text of each input file and returns the Wikifier JSON (annotations, words, spaces).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.label: Language
parameters.description: ISO-639 code of the text (e.g. en, sl, it), or auto to detect it.

parameters.name: secondaryAnnotLanguage
parameters.label: Secondary language
parameters.description: Also report each concept's title and link in this language's Wikipedia.

parameters.name: pageRankSqThreshold
parameters.label: PageRank threshold
parameters.description: Lower values keep fewer, more relevant annotations (e.g. 0.8). -1 disables pruning.

parameters.name: nTopDfValuesToIgnore
parameters.label: Ignore very frequent words
parameters.description: Ignore phrases made only of the N most frequent words (200 is a good start, 0 disables).

outputs.name: annotations
outputs.description: Wikifier JSON: annotations with Wikipedia/Wikidata links, plus the word split of the text.

instructions: Use for entity linking or concept extraction: finding which people, places, organisations and topics a text mentions and linking them to Wikipedia/Wikidata. Input must be plain UTF-8 text (convert PDFs or audio to text first). One call per input file; keep documents to a few tens of thousands of characters. Not for translation, summarisation or sentiment. The public service is occasionally down.
